newsitem.title: USA: CFTC sets comment period for new S&P 500 contract.
newsitem.headline: CFTC sets comment period for new S&P 500 contract.

text.p: Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Thursday it would accept public comments until June 27 on Chicago Mercantile Exchange's proposed contract in futures and options on the Mini Standard & Poor's 500 stock index.

The agency said in a notice published in the Federal Register that it agreed to the CME request for an abbreviated 15-day public comment period. Futures and options with similar terms based on the S&P 500 are already actively traded.
CFTC said the proposed contracts were identical to the actively traded S&P 500 contract, except for the contract size and the minimum price fluctuation.
